title: General List Command With Streaming
prompt: Introduce a general list command that always streams a list of items. By default show everything such as tree but streaming. Only when --sorted is passed, wait until you gathered all the results and sort everything by id. Remove the existing entity-level list and tree subcommands as they are equivalent to list --only-<entity>. Keep all existing tests and extend them to be extensive.
